code: # known: group a has 11 rows, 2 with the outcome, 8 without, 1 missing. # Group b has 11 rows, 6 with the outcome, 4 without, 1 missing. # Odds ratio of b against a: (6 / 4) / (2 / 8) = 6. # null: the outcome does not depend on the group or on x. # confounded: x raises the chance of group b and of the outcome. The log odds # ratio of b against a, adjusted for x, is 0.5. data_raw <- function(scenario, sim) {   if (scenario == "real") {     return(data.table::fread(pbn::folder("main", "d.csv")))   }   if (scenario == "known") {     return(data.table::data.table(       `Person ID` = 1:22,       Group = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 11),       X = rep(c(31, 45, 38, 52, 40, 33, 47, 36, 50, 42, 44), 2),       Outcome = c(rep(c(1, 0, NA), c(2, 8, 1)), rep(c(1, 0, NA), c(6, 4, 1)))     ))   }   conf <- scenario == "confounded"   x <- stats::rnorm(400, 50, 10)   b <- stats::rbinom(400, 1, stats::plogis(conf * (x - 50) / 5))   y <- stats::rbinom(400, 1, stats::plogis(-1 + conf * (0.5 * b + (x - 50) / 10)))   data.table::data.table(     `Person ID` = 1:400,     Group = c("a", "b")[b + 1],     X = replace(round(x), sample(400, 20), NA),     Outcome = y   ) } data_clean <- function(d) {   data.table::setnames(d, janitor::make_clean_names(names(d)))   d[, outcome := as.integer(outcome)]   d } data_cohort <- function(d) {   cp <- cohort::CohortPipeline$new(d)   cp$exclude_and_track("root", "missing outcome", "is.na(outcome)")   cp } data_impute <- function(cp) {   d <- pbn::cohort_data(cp)   fit <- stats::lm(x ~ group + outcome, data = d)   miss <- which(is.na(d$x))   mu <- stats::predict(fit, d[miss])   for (k in seq_len(CFG$data$n_imp)) {     col <- paste0("x_", k)     d[, (col) := x]     data.table::set(d, miss, col, round(mu + stats::rnorm(length(miss), 0, stats::sigma(fit))))   }   d }

code: make_table1 <- function(data, argset) {   pbn::table1(data$d, by = "group", vars = CFG$vars) }  # The predicted risk of each person, from the model of the first imputation. predict_risk <- function(data, argset) {   fit <- stats::glm(outcome ~ group + x_1, family = "binomial", data = data$d)   data.frame(person_id = data$d$person_id, risk = stats::fitted(fit)) } fit_models <- function(data, argset) {   if (plnr::is_run_directly()) {     argset <- pbn::get_argset(p, "confounded", 3, "models")     data <- pbn::get_data(p, "confounded", 3)   }   est <- numeric(0)   w <- numeric(0)   for (k in seq_len(CFG$data$n_imp)) {     rhs <- if (argset$adjust == "none") "group" else paste0("group + x_", k)     fit <- stats::glm(stats::as.formula(paste("outcome ~", rhs)), family = "binomial", data = data$d)     est[k] <- stats::coef(fit)[["groupb"]]     w[k] <- stats::vcov(fit)["groupb", "groupb"]     pbn::progress(k, CFG$data$n_imp, "imputations")   }   # Rubin's rules: the variance within the imputations, plus (1 + 1/m) times   # the variance between them.   se <- sqrt(mean(w) + (1 + 1 / length(est)) * stats::var(est))   z <- stats::qnorm(1 - (1 - CFG$level) / 2)   data.frame(term = "group b", estimate = mean(est), se = se, lower = mean(est) - z * se, upper = mean(est) + z * se) }

code: expect_known <- function(results) {   t1 <- results$table1   observed <- c(     t1$events[t1$var == "outcome" & t1$grp == "b"],     exp(results$crude$estimate)   )   expected <- c(6, 6)   data.frame(     assertion = c("outcome events in group b", "crude odds ratio of b against a"),     expected = expected,     observed = observed,     pass = abs(observed - expected) < 1e-6   ) }  expect_null <- function(results) {   pbn::expect_recovers(results$models, truth = 0, level = CFG$level, label = "adjusted model") }  expect_confounded <- function(results) {   rbind(     pbn::expect_recovers(results$models, truth = 0.5, level = CFG$level, label = "adjusted model"),     pbn::expect_biased(results$crude, truth = 0.5, label = "crude model")   ) } make_output <- function(results, dir) {   pd <- results$table1[var == "outcome" & grp != "All"]   q <- ggplot2::ggplot(pd, ggplot2::aes(x = grp, y = pct))   q <- q + ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "grey40")   q <- q + ggplot2::expand_limits(y = 0)   q <- q + ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01)))   q <- q + ggplot2::labs(x = "Group", y = "With the outcome (%)")   q <- q + ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13)   q <- q + ggplot2::theme(     axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),     axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),     axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "black"),     axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "black")   )   q <- pbn::stamp_fake(q)   ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(dir, "outcome_by_group.png"), q, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 96) }
